strings: When r_c0 and m_c talk about m_c's escapism daydreams, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} very eager and excited to share {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} rich imaginary world.
m_c keeps running in circles around camp, escaping into {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head rather than facing reality.

More and more often, m_c retreats into {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} own world in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head, tail lashing as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/envision/envisions} things that only {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can see.
Sometimes, m_c will narrate fanciful events and stories to the kits.
m_c admits that when daydreaming, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} practice what {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} will talk about with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates.
